name: Blade's Reach

effects.description: Active: Kayn swings his scythe in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% decaying over 1.5 seconds.

Shadow Assassin Bonus: Blade's Reach's radius is extended by 200 units. Kayn conjures an untargetable shadow at the casting position to perform Blade's Reach's sweep over 0.55 seconds in his stead, removing the ability's cast time.
Darkin Slayer Bonus: Blade's Reach knocks up enemies hit for 1 second.

notes:
The shadow is considered an allied champion and can interact with effects such as  World Atlas' and  Runic Compass' Quest and local reward from structures.(bug)
Blade's Reach's indicator is visible to enemies while cast inside terrain and towards enemy champions.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
